Ottawa accelerates defense and digital infrastructure procurement priorities. 🇨🇦

### Aerospace & Defence
Department of Justice Canada initiates a competitive task-based informatics procurement under the TBIPS framework to modernize core legal case management infrastructure through specialized Level 3 business analysts. Execution requires pre-qualified Supply Arrangement holders to integrate technical risk modeling while addressing legacy system maintenance outlays. IT consultants and advisory practices can package sub-contracting and technical integration bids alongside named Supply Arrangement primes such as Procom, S.I. Systems, or Levio Conseils to capture specialized digital transformation scopes.

### Trade Compliance & Regulatory Enforcement
The Canadian International Trade Tribunal has formally initiated an expiry review concerning small power transformers imported from Chinese Taipei and Korea, carrying commercial liabilities related to potential market injury if anti-dumping measures expire without positive determinations by the Canada Border Services Agency by February 2026 and the Tribunal by August 2026. Importers and domestic manufacturers must assemble granular pricing and cost-of-production data to support or contest the continuation of duties during the expiry window. Trade advisory firms can structure comprehensive market participation and injury-defense submissions for industry associations and foreign exporters navigating complex Special Import Measures Act reviews.

### Transportation & Logistics
Canadian Transportation Agency authorities clear international charter flight operations connecting European origins directly to Canadian regional nodes, with non-compliance carrying immediate groundings, civil penalties, and the revocation of landing rights. Ground handlers and logistics providers must coordinate pre-arrival electronic data interchange filings and verify international flight exemptions prior to aircraft touchdown. Advisory practices can structure specialized aviation compliance retainers for international charter operators managing cross-border clearances into regional Canadian airports.

👉 Full dashboard with filters and strategic analysis: https://4mayAi.github.io/canadian-grant-intelligence/trade-compliance/
#DefenseProcurement #TradeCompliance #SupplyChain #AviationRegulation #DigitalTransformation
